subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should this intermediate PR land with a full lineage reparse whenever relevant inputs change, or must the later performance optimization be folded down before merge?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally non-authoritative and functionally contained, but accepting its transient refresh cost is a maintainer-owned merge-risk decision that tests and later-head proof cannot settle.

options.title: Fold down optimization and proof
options.body: Bring the bounded or cached lineage-loading improvement into this PR and attach exact-head cold and changed-corpus runtime evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept the intermediate cost
options.body: Merge in stack order while explicitly accepting the extra changed-input scan cost and landing the later optimization immediately afterward.

recommendation.title: Fold down optimization and proof
recommendation.body: Bring the bounded or cached lineage-loading improvement into this PR and attach exact-head cold and changed-corpus runtime evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release integrator, steipete is the best available owner for accepting or rejecting an intermediate scanner availability tradeoff.
